title: Powder mixture of pre-crosslinked nitrile rubber
abstract: Provided are powdered mixtures based on specific nitrile rubbers and at least one separating agent, and a method for producing curable mixtures and vulcanized rubbers made from these powdered mixtures, as well as the resulting vulcanized rubbers and uses thereof, especially in Use in tire treads where improvements in wet skid resistance, dry grip and rolling resistance are observed with good mixing properties.
